questions.question: Are construction power skids identified, protected and do they have a clearance around them of at least 36" on all sides?
Is all live electrical equipment marked with appropriate identification, information and warning labels, including electrical rooms?

Is a LOTO program in place for the project with Controlling and Authorizing Energy Marshals and a centralized LOTO Station in operation? (Include pictures of the LOTO Station and identify who the Energy Marshals are in the notes)
